scenes.anchor: a tall pivoting matte-walnut wood front door on a smooth white-plaster contemporary home
scenes.justification: A tall pivot front door on smooth white plaster is the textbook bilateral entry anchor; the stone-faced rectangular slab sits perfectly on the flanking plaster planes at door-handle height and reads as architect-specified entry lighting.
scenes.prompt: An exterior portrait of a contemporary architect-designed residence's front entry photographed at standing eye-level on a 50mm lens in a centered 1:1 composition, late twilight. A tall pivoting matte-walnut wood front door sits centered in a smooth white-plaster facade with crisp shadow-line reveals at the head and jambs. A single low broad concrete planter with a sculptural olive tree sits offset to the left of the door on the polished basalt landing. A pair of clipped sago palms in raw concrete cubes anchor the lower edges of the frame. A block of honed grey basalt forms the single entry step. The plaster facade extends cleanly out of frame on both sides. Inside the door, a faint warm glow from a distant interior reads through the narrow side-light. Sky overhead is the soft cobalt-to-dusty-rose gradient of late dusk. Render the wall-mounted fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details. Switched ON, warm amber 2700K (matches the warm glow shown in the variant reference). Palette: warm white plaster, matte walnut, honed basalt grey, cream travertine, deep olive green, cobalt twilight. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people.

scenes.anchor: the two stone pilasters flanking a single tall arched window above a stucco fireplace chimney on an exterior wall
scenes.justification: An arched feature window centered above a stucco chimney mass is a bilateral non-door anchor; flanking the pilasters with two stone-faced sconces frames the window as a feature wall and ties the cloud-stone slabs back to the chimney masonry vocabulary.

A row of clipped lavender hugs the foundation. Inside the arched window, glowing parchment-shade light from an interior fixture warm-ambers through the panes. Soft golden late-day light rakes from the right, throwing the stucco texture into gentle relief. Switched ON, warm amber 2700K (matches the warm glow shown in the variant reference). Palette: cream stucco, limewashed stone, terracotta, weathered teak, dusty lavender purple, deep rosemary green. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people.

scenes.anchor: the long board-formed concrete retaining wall edging an infinity pool deck at dusk
scenes.justification: A long uninterrupted board-formed retaining wall along an infinity pool deck is the canonical linear anchor; three stone-faced slabs at equal intervals at matching mounting height read as zonal architectural accent lighting, not random placement.
scenes.prompt: A hillside modern infinity pool deck photographed at standing eye-level on a 28mm lens in a deep one-point perspective looking down the length of the deck, blue hour. The right side of the frame is a long unbroken board-formed exposed concrete retaining wall running into the distance, its horizontal form lines clearly visible, capped with a clean honed-basalt coping. The deck is large-format honed-travertine pavers, dry. To the left, the infinity edge of the pool drops away into a distant valley view, the still water reflecting the deep cobalt sky. A single low-slung teak chaise with a folded oatmeal linen throw and a small honed-basalt side table holding a stoneware tumbler sit midway down the wall. A row of slim-trunked Italian cypress in raw concrete cube planters stands behind the retaining wall, silhouetted against the dusk sky. The far end of the deck frames a glowing glass-box pavilion with warm interior light spilling across the travertine at the vanishing point. Sky above the open side is deep cobalt twilight bleeding to dusty mauve at the horizon.
